newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares higher mid-bourse on upbeat dollar.
newsitem.headline: German shares higher mid-bourse on upbeat dollar.

text.p: 1040 GMT - German shares traded at higher levels, albeit slightly off earlier highs, as the market continued to enjoy the support of the stronger dollar at 1.7306/11 marks. Firmer overnight close on Wall Street underpinned trade. Resistance seen at 3,400 points, but scepticism about viability of upturn may limit the advance.
* DAX index of bourse trade at 3,379.85 points, up 16.79 points. June DAX future up 3.5 points at 3,387.5.
* Degussa down after H1 gp pre-tax profit up 25 pct at 233 million marks, sales at lower end of forecasts, dealers say.
* Daimler up, says to launch new model in Frankfurt.
